name: systemia-remote-ops
description: Use Systemia Remote Ops when a founder or operator wants to simulate a consequential business decision before changing the real business. The resident Evercraft Compute runtime can route decisions, run a transparent native pricing heuristic, and compare startup, staffing, product/service, expansion, transaction, partnership, capital-purchase, and other scenarios using only explicit caller-supplied assumptions.
